2608.18545.title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages
2608.18545.paper_summary: Multilingual large language models often generalize across languages, and prior work suggests that their internal mechanisms can overlap cross-lingually. It remains unclear, however, when such sharing emerges and whether it varies with the overt realization of the same grammatical operation. We investigate this question for present-tense subject-verb agreement, a morphosyntactic process that varies substantially across languages and is only weakly expressed in English. Using activation patching and attention analysis across 29 languages and five open-source model families, we identify the attention heads causally implicated in agreement and compare these head-level signatures across languages. We find that languages with overt person/number inflection exhibit more similar agreement circuitry than non-conjugating languages, with the strongest sharing appearing when the analysis isolates recovery of the inflectional contrast itself. English provides an informative bridge case, becoming more similar to conjugating languages precisely in contexts where overt agreement is required. Finally, many implicated heads display similar attention patterns across languages, suggesting that cross-lingual overlap reflects shared functional roles as well as shared localization. Together, these results indicate that multilingual LLMs reuse partially shared computational structure for morphosyntactic agreement rather than relying on fully separate language-specific solutions.
2608.18545.paper_summary_zh: 多語言的大型語言模型通常能夠跨語言進行概括，先前的研究表明，它們的內部機制可能在跨語言之間重疊。然而，目前仍不清楚這種共享何時出現，以及它是否會隨著相同語法操作的明顯實現而變化。我們針對現在時的主謂一致性進行了這個問題的研究，這是一個在語言之間變化顯著的形態句法過程，而在英語中表現得相對薄弱。通過在29種語言和五個開源模型系列中使用激活補丁和注意力分析，我們確定了與一致性因果相關的注意力頭，並比較了這些頭部級別的特徵在不同語言之間的差異。我們發現，具有明顯人稱/數量變化的語言在一致性電路上表現出比非變化語言更相似的特徵，當分析專注於恢復變化對比本身時，最強的共享出現。英語提供了一個有趣的橋接案例，在需要明顯一致性的情境中，它變得更像變化語言。最後，許多相關的注意力頭在不同語言中顯示出相似的注意力模式，這表明跨語言的重疊反映了共享的功能角色以及共享的定位。總體而言，這些結果表明，多語言LLM重用部分共享的計算結構來進行形態句法一致性，而不是依賴於完全獨立的語言特定解決方案。
